www.BTNwildlife.org/donate 
BTN is a non-profit wildlife rehabilitation and education center located in Orlando, FL. We accept Florida native injured and orphaned wildlife for rehabilitation and release (approx. 3.5k animals annually). We are open to the public for visitation and educate with our sanctuary animals. We house approx. 30 non-releasable wild animals including rescued ring tailed lemurs, impaired owls, bobcats, fox, goats, tortoises, squirrels and more! 
View btnwildlife.org to learn about BTN and plan your visit.
